Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator prematurely narrowed the search to a small set of TripAdvisor-listed restaurants and moved to check their hours without ensuring the list was complete or optimized by proximity. This excluded closer, late-open options (e.g., McDonald’s) and no distance comparison was performed, leading to selecting Sneekers Cafe instead of the correct closest eatery open at 11pm on Wednesdays.
